title: Wayline Marketing Site
description: A static Astro landing page for a fictional integration platform: a c2-backdrop hero with a rotating c2-text-effect headline and a live dashboard in a c2-device-frame, a c2-marquee logo wall and testimonial columns, a c2-beam integration hub, segmented pricing, an FAQ and a sign-up modal. Below-the-fold components load when their section comes near, like Astro's client:visible.
